intent: When express shipping is selected, the shipping address must be complete — every field in it filled in.
notes: Group-scope field-fill quantifier (new 2026-06-06): NotAllFieldsFilled(<group>) checks the fields INSIDE a group, firing when at least one is empty — distinct from the field-list form NotAllFieldsFilled(a, b). The violation of 'address must be complete when express' is 'express is on AND not all address fields are filled'. Tests (a) the error-scenario polarity (NotAllFieldsFilled, not AllFieldsFilled), (b) recognizing the group-scope form (a single group operand, not a field list), and (c) the boolean literal True (not the string). NON-iterating; ShippingAddress is a non-repeatable group, error field is the trigger ExpressShipping. Gold kernel-verified.
